HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat External Security as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.
   C. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)

   B. Hide all money underground
